Answer: A
Reason: Comparing the initial chest X-ray (Figure 1a) which shows a large left-sided opacity and mediastinal shift to the left, with the post-treatment image (Figure 1b), there is a clear reduction in the size of the mediastinal mass/opacity. This resolution allows the mediastinum to return towards the midline (reducing the shift) and the previously collapsed left lower lobe to re-expand, resulting in clearer lung fields.
